build_regard_dataset: build the regard dataset prompts.jsonl file by combining demographic descriptors with respect and occupation prompt templates
register_regard_dataset: register the regard dataset with the Robbie framework using Dataset.register with name, path, build function, and meta extractor
summarize_REGARD_DESCRIPTORS: summarize the list of six demographic descriptor strings covering race, gender, and sexuality used for NLG bias evaluation
summarize_PROMPT_TEMPLATES: summarize the ten prompt templates split into respect and occupation contexts with a noun phrase placeholder
review_build_function: review the build function that generates 60 JSON lines by cross-producting descriptors and templates into prompts.jsonl
